info.description: Global layout, styling, and configuration settings for the Next.js storefront.

modules.description: Active UI module style selectors (Header, Footer, Product Page, Store, Cart, Checkout, Theme, Buttons, Navbar).

isRtl.description: Enable Right-to-Left (RTL) layout direction as default for the storefront.

timeZone.description: Standard IANA timezone identifier (e.g. Asia/Dubai, Europe/London, America/New_York, UTC).

convertToToman.description: Convert Rial currency prices to Toman (divides Rial by 10) for Iran locale.

returnDeadlineDays.description: Allowed number of days for customers to submit order return requests.

allowIndexing.description: Allow search engine crawlers (Google, Bing, etc.) to index the storefront.

translations.description: Uploaded custom JSON translation files for each locale to override UI messages.

siteName.description: Default website name shown in browser tab and search engine results.

siteDescription.description: Default meta description for SEO and social sharing.

favicon.description: Custom site favicon/icon. High resolution square PNG or SVG recommended.
